## Overview

Local stress check for the optional **Gaussian MMRM** reference path
([`fit_mmrm`](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl/issues/25)):
static treatment, repeated visits, marginal g-computation contrast.

This notebook uses a **synthetic trial DGP** with known treatment×time effects.
It compares `:random_intercept` and `:unstructured` (random-effects) covariance
structures. Random **slopes** for `:marginal` g-computation remain deferred.

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mmrm-stress-env
#| warning: false

using Pkg
const PKG_ROOT = normpath(joinpath(@__DIR__, "..", ".."))
const DOCS_ENV = joinpath(PKG_ROOT, "docs")
Pkg.activate(DOCS_ENV)
Pkg.instantiate()
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mmrm-stress-setup
#| warning: false

using CausalTargeted
using DataFrames
using MixedModels
using StableRNGs
using Statistics

const VISITS = [0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
const β_a = 0.85
const β_at = 0.45

function synthetic_mmrm_trial(;
    n_units::Int = 160,
    rng = StableRNG(20260830),
)
    rows = NamedTuple[]
    for unit in 1:n_units
        W = randn(rng)
        A = Float64(W + 0.6randn(rng) > 0)
        b = 1.1randn(rng)
        for visit in VISITS
            Y = 1.2 + β_a * A + 0.25visit + β_at * A * visit + 0.7W + b + 0.35randn(rng)
            push!(rows, (; id = unit, arm = A, visit, W, Y))
        end
    end
    return DataFrame(rows)
end

known_effect(visit) = β_a + β_at * visit
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mmrm-stress-fit
#| warning: false

data = synthetic_mmrm_trial()
common = (;
    outcome = :Y,
    treatment = :arm,
    time = :visit,
    id = :id,
    baseline = [:W],
    values = (0.0, 1.0),
)

ri = run_mmrm(data; common..., covariance = :random_intercept)
unstr = run_mmrm(data; common..., covariance = :unstructured)

@info "Random intercept max |bias|" maximum(abs.(ri.contrast.effect .- known_effect.(VISITS)))
@info "Unstructured max |bias|" maximum(abs.(unstr.contrast.effect .- known_effect.(VISITS)))
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mmrm-stress-summary
#| warning: false

summary_df = DataFrame(
    covariance = [:random_intercept, :unstructured],
    max_abs_bias = [
        maximum(abs.(ri.contrast.effect .- known_effect.(VISITS))),
        maximum(abs.(unstr.contrast.effect .- known_effect.(VISITS))),
    ],
    min_se = [minimum(ri.contrast.se), minimum(unstr.contrast.se)],
)
summary_df
```

## Pass criteria

- Both covariance modes return finite visit-specific contrasts and SEs.
- Maximum absolute bias vs the known `β_a + β_at * visit` effect is below **0.5**
  on this synthetic draw (generous; unit tests use a tighter gate on a smaller `n`).
- `run_mmrm` contrast matches manual `mixed_g_computation` on the fitted model
  (checked in `test/test_mmrm.jl`).
